dedupe_keys.name: karta dtp open data on road traffic crashes in russia

description: Karta DTP (dtp-stat.ru) is a civic project that republishes Russia's police road-crash records from the official GIBDD site as open data for research, with corrections such as adjusted coordinates. Each crash record carries tags, coordinates, nearby features, road and weather conditions, vehicles (year, colour, category) and participants (health status, driving experience), and pedestrian participants. Coverage: Russian regions (87 regional files were listed on 2026-09-29), from 2015; the Tochno.st flat-table version covers 2015 to 2026. Format and access: zipped GeoJSON per region from dtp-stat.ru; Tochno.st provides CSV (UTF-8, semicolon), XLSX split by region and Parquet, with a PDF data description. Licence and cost: Tochno.st states CC BY 4.0 for its version; dtp-stat.ru states no licence on the download page. Caveats: data are derived from police reports and edited by the project, so they differ from official statistics; the official GIBDD site did not respond from the cloud. The records support crash hotspot analysis and exposure or resilience studies of road links. It relates to GB STATS19 and the India road accidents report in the catalogue.
